Lemma
[Closed eigenforms from homogeneous extensions (Lemma K.27)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0372 ↗ lem:chow-iv-k26-hodge-laplacian-sphere 1. appk:K.27\group Sphere Spectrum

If $\eta $ is a homogeneous degree-$k$ harmonic $p$-form on $\mathbb R^{n+1}$, then $\eta |_{S^n}$ is closed and \[ \Delta _d^{S^n}(\eta |_{S^n})=(k+p)(n-p+k+1)\eta |_{S^n}. \]
